name: open-data-wizard
description: WordPress plugin for publishing open data as DCAT-AP 3.0 compliant metadata
author: Open Data Wizard Team

scripts.env:start: wp-env start && wp-env run cli wp language core install de_DE --activate && wp-env run tests-cli wp language core install de_DE --activate && wp-env run cli wp rewrite structure '/%postname%/' --hard && wp-env run tests-cli wp rewrite structure '/%postname%/' --hard
scripts.env:verify: wp-env run tests-cli wp option get odw_e2e_seeded
